title: [Feature/Graphics]: Bowyer-Watson Delaunay Triangulation and Circumcircle Step-by-Step Debugger
body:
## Problem
Delaunay Triangulation—maximizing the minimum triangle angle via the empty-circumcircle property—is the backbone of terrain meshes, finite-element physics, and Voronoi duality, yet ArcadeVerse has no step-by-step Bowyer-Watson computational geometry studio.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 280+ LOC of exact geometric predicates, Bowyer-Watson stepper & Canvas UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/delaunay-bowyer-watson.js`:
     - Implement **Bowyer-Watson incremental Delaunay algorithm** with exact determinant circumcircle test (`inCircumcircle(p, a, b, c)`), super-triangle initialization & cleanup, bad-triangle cavity detection, polygon hole boundary edge extraction, and dual **Voronoi cell extraction** by connecting adjacent circumcenters!
     - Support an interactive **Sub-Step Animator** letting users add/drag points and inspect each point's insertion phase (`1: Highlight Violated Circumcircles`, `2: Carve Polygonal Cavity`, `3: Fan Re-Triangulate Cavity`), plus toggle overlays for Circumcenters, Empty Circles, and Dual Voronoi edges.
   - Create `assets/css/delaunay-bowyer-watson.css`:
     - Geometry lab toolbar with Random/Grid/Poisson presets, Click-to-Insert/Drag points, Step-Forward / Auto-Play controls, and min-angle / triangle-count stats.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas/CSS3, zero external geometry libraries (no Delaunator/D3), zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-delaunay-bowyer-watson.js` (`node:test`) asserting strict **Delaunay Empty-Circumcircle invariant** across every vertex-triangle pair for random, collinear-edge, and square point sets, plus Euler formula planar checks (`V - E + F`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Bowyer-Watson produces valid Delaunay meshes satisfying the empty-circumcircle property for arbitrary point clouds.
- [ ] Step-by-step debugger highlights violating circumcircles, polygonal cavities, and dual Voronoi edges cleanly.
- [ ] Dragging existing vertices updates triangulation and dual Voronoi diagram smoothly in real time.
- [ ] Code spans 280+ meaningful lines across isolated files without editing protected core files.
- [ ] Unit test `scripts/test-delaunay-bowyer-watson.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Content-Aware Seam Carving Image Resizer Using Dynamic Programming Energy Maps
body:
## Problem
Naive image scaling squashes foreground subjects, whereas Avidan & Shamir's **Seam Carving** algorithm computes Sobel/gradient pixel energy maps and removes lowest-energy connected pixel seams via Dynamic Programming—an impressive visual CS lab missing from ArcadeVerse.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 290+ LOC of pixel DP solver, offscreen image generator & Canvas UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/seam-carving-dp.js`:
     - Generate 3–4 rich **self-contained procedural sample scenes** onto offscreen `ImageData` (e.g., Sunset Archipelago + Lighthouse silhouette, Geometric Pyramid Pillars, Low-Poly Mountains) plus support local user image upload via `FileReader` (resized safely to `<= 320px` for instant interactive performance) AND a brush to paint **Protected Green Keep Masks / Red Remove Masks**!
     - Implement dual-gradient energy function (`|dI/dx| + |dI/dy|`), Forward/Backward Dynamic Programming cumulative-energy matrix `M[y][x]`, lowest-energy vertical & horizontal seam backtracking, pixel shift carving, and animated red seam highlighting before each carve step!
   - Create `assets/css/seam-carving-dp.css`:
     - Split visual studio showing Target Image Canvas + Live Energy Heatmap toggle + Width/Height target sliders + Keep/Remove Protect Brush controls.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/HTML5 Canvas `ImageData`, zero external image libraries or remote stock URLs, zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-seam-carving-dp.js` verifying gradient energy calculation on step-edge test buffers, DP cumulative minimum seam cost exactness on small pixel grids, 8-connected seam path continuity (`|col[y] - col[y-1]| <= 1`), and exact output width reduction.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Content-aware seam carving preserves foreground objects far better than uniform horizontal/vertical scaling.
- [ ] Users can view raw gradient energy heatmaps, highlight lowest-energy red seams step-by-step, and paint Keep/Remove masks.
- [ ] Procedural test images and optional local image uploads carve smoothly without freezing the main thread.

title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Interactive Sweep-Line Bentley-Ottmann Segment Intersection Debugger
body:
## Problem
Finding all `k` intersections among `N` line segments drops from brute-force `O(N^2)` to output-sensitive `O((N+k) log N)` via the classic **Bentley-Ottmann Sweep-Line Algorithm**—an algorithm packed with subtle geometric degeneracies that makes an exceptional interactive debugger.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 280+ LOC of event queue, sweep-line status tree & Canvas debugger):**
   - Create `assets/js/bentley-ottmann-sweep.js`:
     - Implement full **Bentley-Ottmann Sweep-Line** solver using an ordered Event Priority Queue (`LEFT_ENDPOINT`, `RIGHT_ENDPOINT`, `INTERSECTION` events sorted lexicographically by `(x, y)`) and active **Sweep-Line Status Order Structure** ordered by vertical `y(x_sweep)` coordinate.
     - Handle tricky degenerate cases cleanly (vertical segments, multiple segments meeting at one intersection, shared endpoints) and verify parity dynamically against an internal brute-force reference oracle!
     - Render interactive Canvas allowing users to draw/drag custom line segments or load stress presets (`Random Crosshatch`, `Parallel Dense Grid`, `Starburst Shared Vertex`), step event-by-event while sliding a glowing **Vertical Sweep Line**, and inspect the live Active Segment Status list + Event Queue!
   - Create `assets/css/bentley-ottmann-sweep.css`:
     - Computational geometry workbench pairing Canvas sweep view with live Status Order panel, Upcoming Event Priority Queue list, and `Sweep Ops` vs `Brute-Force Checks` counter.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas/CSS3, zero external geometry libraries, zero emojis.
3. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-bentley-ottmann-sweep.js` comparing Bentley-Ottmann intersection sets against `O(N^2)` ground truth across randomized segments, vertical lines, shared endpoints, and disjoint parallel clusters.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Sweep line advances event-by-event (`Left`, `Right`, `Intersection`), maintaining accurate vertical order swaps.
- [ ] Handles vertical segments and multi-way intersections accurately with 100% parity vs `O(N^2)` reference checks.
- [ ] Operation counter visibly proves asymptotic speedup on sparse-intersection layouts.
- [ ] Total new code spans 280+ meaningful lines across isolated files without modifying protected files.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-bentley-ottmann-sweep.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Interactive 2D Signed Distance Field Raymarching Sphere-Trace Stepper and CSG Lab
body:
## Problem
Signed Distance Fields (`SDF`) and Sphere Tracing power modern procedural shader art, smooth Constructive Solid Geometry (`CSG` Union/Subtraction/Smooth-Min blending), and soft shadows, yet shader newbies struggle to understand how rays "march" safely by radius steps.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 280+ LOC of SDF primitives, CSG evaluator, sphere-tracer & Canvas UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/sdf-raymarch-stepper.js`:
     - Implement exact analytical 2D SDF primitives (`Circle`, `Oriented Box`, `Capsule`, `Equilateral Triangle`, `Hexagon`) and CSG operators (`Union`, `Intersection`, `Difference`, and polynomial **Smooth Minimum `smin(a, b, k)`** organic metaball blending!).
     - Render configurable **Iso-Contour Distance Field Band Map** (`SDF < 0` interior vs concentric positive distance isolines) and let users drag/rotate an interactive Ray Emitter casting **Sphere-Tracing March Circles** step-by-step, plotting every circle radius `r_i = evalSDF(p_i)` until surface hit or miss!
     - Also compute soft penumbra shadow rays (`k * d / t`) and numerical surface normals (`gradient(p)`) at impact!
   - Create `assets/css/sdf-raymarch-stepper.css`:
     - Shader-dev sandbox with draggable CSG primitive list, Smooth-`k` blend slider, Step-Cap scrubber, Isoline colormap toggle, and live step telemetry (`Steps`, `Hit Distance`, `Normal`).
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas/CSS3, zero external math/WebGL helper libs, zero emojis.
3. Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-sdf-raymarch-stepper.js` testing exact negative-inside / zero-boundary / positive-outside SDF invariants, CSG subtraction/intersection logic, smooth-min `C1` bounds (`smin(a, b, k) <= min(a, b)`), and sphere-trace convergence steps.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Analytical 2D SDF primitives and CSG operators (`Union`, `Difference`, `Smooth-Min`) render crisp distance isolines.
- [ ] Dragging the ray emitter animates exact Sphere-Tracing circles tangent to nearest geometry at every march step.
- [ ] Smooth blending `k` visibly merges separate shapes smoothly while preserving valid conservative step radii.
- [ ] Total new code exceeds 280 meaningful lines across isolated files without modifying protected root files.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-sdf-raymarch-stepper.js` passes cleanly under `node`.

title: [Feature/Physics]: Ideal-Gas Pressure-Filled Verlet Soft-Body Balloon and Tire Physics Engine
body:
## Problem
Simulating squishy pressurized soft bodies—like bouncy rubber balloons, pressurized tires, or jelly rings that squeeze through narrow funnels and rebound cleanly—combines Verlet edge springs with the **Ideal Gas Law** (`P = nRT / Volume` via Shoelace Polygon Area!), a compelling physics model absent from ArcadeVerse.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 290+ LOC of Verlet solver, Shoelace area pressure & interactive Canvas arena):**
   - Create `assets/js/verlet-softbody-gas.js`:
     - Represent soft-body loops as closed rings of `N` Verlet mass nodes linked by stretch + bending distance constraints, computing instantaneous internal **signed Polygon Area** (`Shoelace Formula`) and applying outward edge-normal **Gas Pressure Force** proportional to `(targetArea * pressureMultiplier) / currentArea`!
     - Support multi-body soft-body collisions (point-in-polygon / segment-vs-vertex pushback), angled obstacle ramps, a **Pressure Pump (+/-)** inflation control (with optional over-inflation pop bursting effect!), and Mouse Grab-and-Throw / Funnel Squeeze test arenas!
     - Render smooth closed Catmull-Rom / quadratic-spline inflated skins, optional internal stress-spring wireframe overlay, and live `Area %` / `Internal Pressure (kPa)` telemetry.
   - Create `assets/css/verlet-softbody-gas.css`:
     - Physics playground controls for Gas Pressure `nRT`, Membrane Stiffness, Gravity, Spawn Balloon/Tire/Blob presets, and Wireframe Stress X-Ray view.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas/CSS3, zero external physics engines (no Matter.js/Box2D), zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-verlet-softbody-gas.js` verifying Shoelace signed polygon area exactness on rectangles/circles, positive outward normal force orientation on compressed polygons, constraint convergence iterations, and NaN/blowup clamping under extreme compression.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Soft bodies dynamically squish through obstacles and preserve internal area realistically under Ideal-Gas pressure forces.
- [ ] Adjusting gas pressure visibly inflates, firms up, or deflates loops in real time without solver explosions.
- [ ] Multiple soft bodies bounce against walls, ramps, and each other smoothly with interactive mouse drag.
- [ ] Total new code spans 290+ meaningful lines across isolated files without editing protected files.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Bridson Poisson-Disc Blue-Noise Sampling and Weighted Stipple Art Generator
body:
## Problem
Uniform random dots (`white noise`) create ugly clumps and gaps, whereas **Bridson's `O(N)` Poisson-Disc Sampling** produces organic blue-noise distributions used in procedural foliage placement, anti-aliasing, and weighted halftone stipple art—capabilities absent from ArcadeVerse.

1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 260+ LOC of Bridson spatial grid sampler, LBG/Lloyd relaxation & Canvas UI):**

     - Extend into **Variable-Density Importance Sampling & Weighted Voronoi Stippling** (using 2–3 iterations of weighted relaxation against procedural grayscale portraits/gradients or uploaded small images!) plus a live **2D FFT Spatial Power Spectrum (`Radial Blue-Noise Donut`)** proving the absence of low-frequency clumping compared to White Noise!

title: [Feature/Algorithms]: Interactive 2D K-D Tree Spatial Partitioning and K-Nearest-Neighbor Pruning Lab
body:
## Problem
Scanning millions of points for nearest neighbors drops from `O(N)` to `O(log N)` using balanced **K-D Trees** and bounding-hypersphere branch pruning, yet learning how hypersphere overlap triggers backtracking across splitting planes is opaque without an interactive spatial debugger.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 270+ LOC of balanced K-D Tree builder, KNN pruning searcher & Canvas UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/kdtree-knn-lab.js`:
     - Build balanced **2D K-D Tree** (`splitAxis = depth % 2`, median partitioning) supporting dynamic point insertion, region **Orthogonal Range Box Query** (`[x1..x2, y1..y2]`), and **K-Nearest-Neighbor (`k = 1..10`) Priority-Queue Search** with step-by-step trace recording (`visit-node`, `update-best`, `prune-branch`, `backtrack-crosses-plane`)!
     - Render crisp alternating vertical/horizontal **splitting partition lines** colored by depth, glowing `k`-radius search hyperspheres, greyed-out **Pruned Subtrees** skipped without visiting, and live tree hierarchy diagram / speedup counter vs Linear Scan!
   - Create `assets/css/kdtree-knn-lab.css`:
     - Spatial index dashboard with Click-to-Add Points, Query Cursor / Drag Range Box modes, `K` neighbor count slider, Step Debugger controls, and Visits Saved metric.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas/CSS3, zero external spatial libraries, zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-kdtree-knn-lab.js` validating exact KNN results (matching sorted brute-force Euclidean distances across uniform, clustered, and duplicate-coordinate datasets for `k=1, 3, 7`) and exact range-query completeness.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] K-D Tree renders recursive orthogonal partitions clearly and updates smoothly as points are added or cleared.
- [ ] KNN Search accurately prunes non-overlapping subtrees and highlights backtracking whenever search radius crosses a split line.
- [ ] All KNN and Rectangular Range queries match brute-force ground truth 100% across unit tests.

title: [Feature/Physics]: Meshing Spur Gear-Train Angular Velocity and Jam-Lock Kinematics Sandbox
body:
## Problem
Mechanical gear trains—compound shafts, planetary rings, odd-cycle mechanical **jam-locks**, and involute tooth-count torque-vs-RPM ratios—combine geometry and kinematics into tactile mechanical puzzles currently missing from ArcadeVerse.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 280+ LOC of involute gear renderer, graph kinematics solver & UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/spur-gear-kinematics.js`:
     - Render procedurally generated **meshing involute/trapezoidal-profile Spur Gears** parameterized by Tooth Count (`Z = 8..48`), fixed Module Pitch `m` (so `R_pitch = m * Z / 2` guarantees accurate tooth meshing!), phase-offset angular alignment (`theta_B`), and coaxial **Compound Gear** shaft stacking!
     - Implement graph-based **Kinematic Propagation & Jam Detection Solver** (BFS/DFS angular velocity traversal propagating `omega_B = -omega_A * (Z_A / Z_B)` and `torque_B = -torque_A * (Z_B / Z_A)`, detecting **Odd-Loop Mechanical Jam Locks** or incompatible tooth ratio conflicts and halting jammed loops with red flash warnings!).
     - Allow snapping new gears onto empty canvas, toggling Motor Driver direction/RPM, locking coaxial shafts, and solving **4 built-in Mechanical Ratio Challenges** (e.g., build an exact `12:1` reduction train without jamming!).
   - Create `assets/css/spur-gear-kinematics.css`:
     - Drafting-table workshop UI with Tooth-Count selector, Motor Torque/RPM gauges, Coaxial Weld tool, Ratio Readout table, and Challenge selector.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/2D Canvas/CSS3, zero external CAD/physics engines, zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-spur-gear-kinematics.js` verifying pitch-radius mesh distance math, gear-train angular velocity & torque ratio propagation across multi-gear + compound shafts, and accurate detection of odd-cycle jam locks.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Meshing gears snap cleanly at exact pitch distances and rotate visually with zero tooth overlap or slippage.
- [ ] Coaxial compound shafts and branched trains propagate exact angular speeds and mechanical advantage ratios.

title: [Feature/Graphics]: Descartes Circle Theorem Apollonian Fractal Gasket Complex Solver Studio
body:
## Problem
Complex Descartes Circle Theorem—solving mutually tangent circle curvatures AND centers simultaneously in the complex plane via `k4 = k1 + k2 + k3 +/- 2*sqrt(k1*k2 + k2*k3 + k3*k1)` and `z4*k4 = z1*k1 + z2*k2 + z3*k3 +/- 2*sqrt(...)`—creates mesmerizing Apollonian Fractal Gaskets that ArcadeVerse does not yet explore.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 270+ LOC of complex arithmetic solver, BFS gasket generator & Canvas UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/apollonian-gasket-studio.js`:
     - Implement dedicated `Complex(re, im)` algebraic library (`add`, `sub`, `mul`, `div`, `sqrt` choosing both complex square-root branches cleanly).
     - Implement **Complex Descartes Circle Theorem solver** supporting mutually tangent 3-circle seeds (including an enclosing negative-curvature `-k` outer boundary circle!) and recursive **BFS Priority-Queue Gasket Generator** parameterized by depth / minimum pixel radius `r_min` + duplicate-circle hash deduplication.
     - Allow dragging/tuning **Integral Apollonian Seeds** (such as famous `(-1, 2, 2, 3)` Ford-circle packing where EVERY recursively spawned circle has an exact integer curvature!) with optional Ford-number curvature labels drawn inside circles, zoom/pan navigation, and high-res PNG/SVG export!

Add standalone unit test `scripts/test-apollonian-gasket-studio.js` verifying `Complex.sqrt` precision, Descartes curvature sum identity `2*(k1^2+k2^2+k3^2+k4^2) == (k1+k2+k3+k4)^2`, exact integer-curvature generation for `(-1, 2, 2, 3)`, and tangent distance invariants between generated child circles.

## Acceptance Criteria

title: [Feature/Tools]: Recursive-Descent JSON Structural Diff Tree and Query Path Evaluator Workbench
body:
## Problem
Comparing deeply nested JSON payloads, game configs, and save states using naive line-by-line text diff breaks whenever object keys reorder. ArcadeVerse lacks a true structural semantic JSON Diff engine paired with a custom JSON-Path query evaluator.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Substantial Implementation Scope (Minimum 270+ LOC of custom JSON parser/path query engine, Myers/structural diff & UI):**
   - Create `assets/js/json-structural-diff.js`:
     - Implement order-independent recursive **Semantic Tree Diffing** (`ADDED`, `REMOVED`, `MODIFIED`, `TYPE_CHANGED`, `UNCHANGED`) plus **LCS (Longest Common Subsequence) Array Alignment** (optionally keying object arrays by ID field like `"id"` or `"name"` so moved array items show as reordered rather than massive false deletes!).
     - Implement a standalone **Recursive-Descent Query Path Evaluator** supporting dot paths, bracket indices, wildcards (`$.games[*].title`), array slices (`[0:3]`), and recursive descent (`$..difficulty`), highlighting matched tree nodes live!
     - Generate collapsible dual side-by-side DOM Tree Views + synchronized scroll & RFC 6902 **JSON Patch (`add`/`remove`/`replace`)** export!
   - Create `assets/css/json-structural-diff.css`:
     - Clean developer diff workbench with dual editors, LCS array-key input, Query Path bar with live match count, Summary badges, and Fold-Unchanged toggle.
2. Pure Vanilla JS/HTML5/CSS3, zero external diff/lodash/jsonpath packages, zero emojis.
3. Add unit test `scripts/test-json-structural-diff.js` verifying key-reordering invariance (`{"a":1,"b":2}` vs `{"b":2,"a":1}` yields 0 diffs), LCS array insertion/deletion alignment, RFC 6902 patch generation correctness, and recursive-descent `$..key` query matching.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Object key permutations produce zero false diffs while nested value/type mutations report exact structural paths.
- [ ] Array LCS and key-based object array alignment accurately separate shifts from real edits.
- [ ] Recursive-descent query bar (`$..`, `[*]`, slices) filters and highlights matching nodes cleanly alongside valid RFC 6902 patch export.
- [ ] Total new code exceeds 270 lines across isolated files without modifying protected core files.
- [ ] Test script `scripts/test-json-structural-diff.js` passes cleanly under `node`.
